title: gnss_ros_standardization: A ROS 2 framework for receiver-independent handling of raw GNSS observations
description: ROS 2 package that publishes GNSS raw observations and navigation data from u-blox, Septentrio, NovAtel and RTCM3 receivers as one common set of messages, with drivers, bag/RINEX converters and positioning nodes (SPP, RTK, EKF, FGO).
